text: You’re on the perfect date, laughing under the stars…
When suddenly, something falls from the sky.
A blinding flash turns everything white.
Windows explode. Cars fly through the air.
Then a hand reaches through the dust.
Gray dust begins blowing through a crack beneath the door.
Then you notice your date staring at your arm.
A strange burn covers your skin.
Your phone crackles one last time:
Outside, the entire city goes silent.
